title: Drip Feed! - Bathroom Of The Month & A Chat With Kirsten Stanisich
bodyHtml:
Uncovering Design Ethos with Kirsten Stanisich

Join us on this month's episode of the Architect & Interior Designer Show as we sit down with Kirsten Stanisich, Director and Co-Founder of Richards Stanisich, a multi-award winning Design Practice based in Surry Hills, Sydney. Come along as we explore her approach and philosophy behind award-winning design, a must listen for the design curious.

Watch Now

St. Peters by Little Road Interior Design

 

Designed by Little Road

Photograpy by Swell Studios

When Little Road were asked to design this stunning St. Peters Bathroom, they were presented with a challenging brief - Incorporate an ensuite within a limited footprint, in a space without natural light.

The completed bathroom is not only beautiful, but adheres to the clients’ key functional concerns - Maximise bench space, have ample storage and lower the need for constant maintenance.

A skylight was installed in the ceiling and glass was added to the exterior door, breathing new life into the space. A clever vanity with limited projection but plenty of width provides abundant storage without stealing precious floor space.

“The constrained width of the space necessitated a thoughtful approach to the vanity unit’s depth, leading us to craft a visually striking design with a shallow profile, complemented by subtle curves for added visual intrigue”

- Marcus Syvertsen | Director & Principal Interior Designer

Large format tiles were selected to limit grout lines and a curved shower wall eliminated the need for a glass screen or door further reducing cleaning maintenance.
